verdict.rationale: The M4 Max is a hardware system-on-chip, not a software tool, so running it headlessly or invoking it in a CI pipeline is a category error for this product type. The evidence covers performance and developer frameworks (Xcode builds, MLX, Metal) but shows no headless or CI execution mode of the chip itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
